sections.description:
Wptrivo Direct Chat – Lite helps you convert more visitors into customers by allowing them to contact you instantly through WhatsApp from any page on your website.

Add a clean, customizable WhatsApp chat button or agent box to your WordPress or WooCommerce site — no coding required.

Perfect for:
✅ Customer Support
✅ Sales & Pre-sales Questions
✅ WooCommerce Stores
✅ Service-based Businesses

🔥 Key Benefits

  • Add a floating WhatsApp chat button in seconds
  • Connect with visitors instantly via WhatsApp
  • Improve conversion rate and response time
  • 100% mobile-friendly and lightweight
  • Works perfectly with WooCommerce product pages
  • No data stored on your server – GDPR friendly

  • Beginner-friendly UI

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Wptrivo Direct Chat in your dashboard
  4. Add your WhatsApp number and customize settings
  5. Save changes and your chat button is now live!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, it works perfectly with WooCommerce and supports product/chat redirection.

Can I add more than one WhatsApp number?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple agents/numbers.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. It is fully responsive on all devices.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. This plugin does not store any personal data. All communication happens through WhatsApp.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Everything is beginner-friendly and point-and-click.
